name: Celestial Astrolabe Atoll
core_rationale: Eleventh floating basalt-and-brass ring island of Continent 03 where Vesper's outer orbital tether interlocks with giant starlight armillary spheres.
local_conflict: Armillary sentinel constructs and starlight-winged moths circle the rotating celestial rings.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Shearing orbital starlight across Equinox-Zenith Arch requires Astrolabe-Keeper Caelum's Celestial Vernier Key.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Star-navigators say Celestial Astrolabe Atoll aligns its brass armillary rings once every hour to point toward hidden star-shoals.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Nested starlight-and-brass armillary rings rotating around a floating basalt atoll.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What celestial chart-chamber sits at the center of Equinox-Zenith Arch?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the outer armillary ring of Continent 03 and connects west to Penumbra Prism Haven.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Nested starlight-and-brass armillary rings rotating around a floating basalt atoll.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m armillary bridge walkways, 0.58m astrolabe chart desks, and 0.14m basalt risers tailored to 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix at [0,1], [1,1], [1,1] floor -1, and [1,0] with celestial and construct monster families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-equinox-zenith-arch in Mystery status behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_reason.
